message.reasoning_content: The key risk: step() returns weights.view(N) — a view of the mutated buffer, so retained history tensors all alias the same storage; at observation time all six "history" entries equal w[6]. The contract says aliasing itself is not failure — only values at observation time matter. So H[t] = w[6] for all t ≠ w[t+1] → history error large. That's the mutation_audit family trick.
